_note: 官方版式库清单(由版式生成器产出)。每个版式一个目录,slots.json 是槽位说明。

summary.zh-CN: 一个数字占满视觉重心:数字 + 单位 + 一句副标
summary.en-US: One number owns the card: value + unit + one supporting line

pick.zh-CN: 回答「现在是多少」的单个量:步数、余额、粉丝数、温度、待办数
pick.en-US: A single "how much right now": steps, balance, followers, temperature, open tasks

summary.zh-CN: 价格 + 涨跌幅胶囊,涨跌色跟用户习惯(红涨 / 绿涨)
summary.en-US: Price + change pill, coloured by the user's up/down convention

pick.zh-CN: 价格、汇率、指数、任何「比上一次涨了还是跌了」的量
pick.en-US: Prices, rates, indices — anything that went up or down since last time

summary.zh-CN: 数字 + 一条近期走势线;给了涨跌幅就按涨跌上色,否则用源色
summary.en-US: A number + its recent shape; coloured by change when given, accent otherwise

pick.zh-CN: 要看「最近是往上还是往下」的量:行情、体重、访问量、温度
pick.en-US: Anything where the recent direction matters: prices, weight, traffic, temperature

summary.zh-CN: 3–5 行:每行一个名字 + 一个值(大档再加一行小字)
summary.en-US: 3–5 rows: a name and a value per row (plus a small line on the large size)

pick.zh-CN: 几条并列的东西:待办、最近的提交、几只自选、几个服务
pick.en-US: A few parallel items: tasks, recent commits, a watchlist, services

summary.zh-CN: 完成了多少 / 目标多少:方形是进度环,迷你是进度条
summary.en-US: Done vs. goal: a ring on the square size, a bar on the mini size

pick.zh-CN: 有明确目标的量:今日步数 / 目标、预算用了多少、读书进度、配额
pick.en-US: Anything with a target: steps vs. goal, budget used, reading progress, quota

summary.zh-CN: 离某一天还有 N 天;当天显示「就是今天」,过了显示已过几天
summary.en-US: N days until a date; "Today" on the day, days since afterwards

pick.zh-CN: 纪念日、假期、截止日、发布日

summary.zh-CN: 最近每天做没做:方形 7×5(35 天),宽档 7×15(105 天),右下角是今天
summary.en-US: Did it happen each day: 7×5 (35 days) square, 7×15 (105 days) wide; bottom-right is today

pick.zh-CN: 习惯、运动、喝水、学习这类按天记的事
pick.en-US: Habits, workouts, water, study — anything logged per day

summary.zh-CN: 同一个量在 2–3 个对象之间并排比,最大的那个用源色标出
summary.en-US: One measure side by side across 2–3 things; the largest is marked in the accent

pick.zh-CN: 几个城市的气温、几个账户的余额、几个渠道的下载量
pick.en-US: Temperatures in a few cities, balances across accounts, downloads per channel

summary.zh-CN: 一盏灯回答「正常吗」:正常 / 留意 / 故障 / 未知四态
summary.en-US: One light answers "is it OK": ok / warn / down / unknown

pick.zh-CN: 服务、网站、设备、任务是否正常
pick.en-US: Is a service, site, device or job OK

summary.zh-CN: 前 N 名带名次:名字 + 数值,大档每行再带一根相对长度条
summary.en-US: Top N with rank numbers: name + value; the large size adds a relative bar per row

pick.zh-CN: 榜单、按量排序的东西:最热文章、花钱最多的分类、最常用的 App
pick.en-US: Leaderboards and sorted things: top posts, biggest spending categories, most-used apps

summary.zh-CN: 下一件事:什么事、几点、还有多久、在哪
summary.en-US: What's next: the event, when, how long until, where

pick.zh-CN: 下一个会议、下一节课、下一班车、下一次服药
pick.en-US: The next meeting, class, train or dose

summary.zh-CN: 两个不同的量各占一块:标签在上、数字在下
summary.en-US: Two different measures, one block each: label above, number below

pick.zh-CN: 成对出现的两个量:收入与订单、今日与本月、上传与下载
pick.en-US: Two numbers that belong together: revenue and orders, today and this month, up and down
